customRules.pbl_rules.yaml:
- rule: PBL Normal Configuration Read
  desc: Expected application configuration read
  condition: >
    container and evt.type in (open, openat, openat2) and
    proc.name = cat and fd.name in (/etc/hostname, /www/index.html) and
    container.name = frontend
  output: >
    PBL_EVENT scenario=normal case=openmetadata action=config_read
    file=%fd.name process=%proc.name command=%proc.cmdline
    container=%container.name pod=%k8s.pod.name namespace=%k8s.ns.name
  priority: Informational
  tags: [pbl, normal, openmetadata]

- rule: PBL Normal Temporary File Activity
  desc: Expected temporary file write by an administrator
  condition: >
    container and evt.type in (open, openat, openat2) and
    evt.is_open_write=true and fd.name startswith /tmp/openmetadata-normal and
    container.name = frontend
  output: >
    PBL_EVENT scenario=normal case=openmetadata action=temp_file_write
    file=%fd.name process=%proc.name command=%proc.cmdline
    container=%container.name pod=%k8s.pod.name namespace=%k8s.ns.name
  priority: Informational
  tags: [pbl, normal, openmetadata]

- rule: PBL Normal Curl Health Check
  desc: Expected curl health check from the frontend Pod
  condition: >
    container and evt.type in (open, openat, openat2) and
    evt.is_open_write=true and
    fd.name = /tmp/openmetadata-health-response
  output: >
    PBL_EVENT scenario=normal case=openmetadata action=health_check
    file=%fd.name process=%proc.name command=%proc.cmdline
    container=%container.name pod=%k8s.pod.name namespace=%k8s.ns.name
  priority: Informational
  tags: [pbl, normal, openmetadata]

- rule: PBL OpenMetadata Environment Discovery
  desc: Environment and credential discovery after a simulated OpenMetadata compromise
  condition: >
    container and spawned_process and
    (proc.name = env or (proc.name = cat and proc.args contains /proc/1/environ)) and
    container.name = backend
  output: >
    PBL_EVENT scenario=abnormal_1 case=openmetadata action=credential_environment_discovery
    file=<NA> process=%proc.name command=%proc.cmdline
    container=%container.name pod=%k8s.pod.name namespace=%k8s.ns.name
  priority: Warning
  tags: [pbl, abnormal, openmetadata, discovery]

- rule: PBL OpenMetadata ServiceAccount Token Access
  desc: ServiceAccount token access after a simulated OpenMetadata compromise
  condition: >
    container and evt.type in (open, openat, openat2) and
    proc.name = cat and fd.name contains kubernetes.io/serviceaccount and
    fd.name endswith token and container.name = backend
  output: >
    PBL_EVENT scenario=abnormal_2 case=openmetadata action=serviceaccount_token_read
    file=%fd.name process=%proc.name command=%proc.cmdline
    container=%container.name pod=%k8s.pod.name namespace=%k8s.ns.name
  priority: Warning
  tags: [pbl, abnormal, openmetadata, credential_access]

- rule: PBL OpenMetadata Payload Execution
  desc: Safe local payload execution that represents shell or payload execution
  condition: >
    container and spawned_process and proc.name = sh and
    proc.args contains /tmp/openmetadata-payload.sh and
    container.name = frontend
  output: >
    PBL_EVENT scenario=abnormal_3 case=openmetadata action=payload_shell_exec
    file=/tmp/openmetadata-payload.sh process=%proc.name command=%proc.cmdline
    container=%container.name pod=%k8s.pod.name namespace=%k8s.ns.name
  priority: Warning
  tags: [pbl, abnormal, openmetadata, execution]
customRules.pbl_rules_v2.yaml:
- list: pbl_v2_workload_containers
  items: [frontend, backend, curl-client]

- list: pbl_v2_shell_programs
  items: [sh, bash, dash, ash, ksh, zsh]

- macro: pbl_v2_workload
  condition: >
    container and k8s.ns.name = pbl-security and
    container.name in (pbl_v2_workload_containers)

- rule: PBL V2 Sensitive File Open
  desc: >
    A demo workload successfully opened a sensitive file for reading.
    This records read-capable open success, not proof that bytes were read.
  condition: >
    evt.type in (open, openat, openat2) and evt.rawres >= 0 and
    evt.is_open_read = true and pbl_v2_workload and
    (
      fd.name in (/proc/1/environ, /etc/shadow, /root/.aws/credentials,
                  /root/.ssh/id_rsa, /root/.kube/config) or
      (
        (fd.name startswith /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ or
         fd.name startswith /run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/) and
        fd.name endswith /token
      )
    )
  output: >
    PBL_V2_EVENT detection=sensitive_file_open
    event_time_ns=%evt.rawtime event_type=%evt.type result=%evt.rawres
    file=%fd.name process=%proc.name executable=%proc.exepath
    command=%proc.cmdline pid=%proc.pid tid=%thread.tid ppid=%proc.ppid
    parent=%proc.pname parent_command=%proc.pcmdline
    container_id=%container.id container=%container.name
    pod=%k8s.pod.name namespace=%k8s.ns.name
  priority: Warning
  tags: [pbl_v2, credential_access, file_access]

- rule: PBL V2 Temporary Program Execution
  desc: >
    A demo workload launched a binary from a temporary directory or a shell
    whose argument string begins with an absolute temporary-script path.
    Options before the script, relative paths, sourcing and inline scripts
    are known gaps. An authorized temporary script can still trigger this.
  condition: >
    evt.type in (execve, execveat) and evt.rawres >= 0 and
    pbl_v2_workload and
    (
      proc.exepath startswith /tmp/ or
      proc.exepath startswith /var/tmp/ or
      proc.exepath startswith /dev/shm/ or
      (
        proc.name in (pbl_v2_shell_programs) and
        (proc.args startswith /tmp/ or
         proc.args startswith /var/tmp/ or
         proc.args startswith /dev/shm/)
      )
    )
  output: >
    PBL_V2_EVENT detection=temp_program_exec
    event_time_ns=%evt.rawtime event_type=%evt.type result=%evt.rawres
    process=%proc.name executable=%proc.exepath arguments=%proc.args
    command=%proc.cmdline pid=%proc.pid tid=%thread.tid ppid=%proc.ppid
    parent=%proc.pname parent_command=%proc.pcmdline
    container_id=%container.id container=%container.name
    pod=%k8s.pod.name namespace=%k8s.ns.name
  priority: Warning
  tags: [pbl_v2, execution, temporary_directory]

- rule: PBL V2 Environment Inspection
  desc: >
    Record environment inspection for context. The env command alone is
    also normal troubleshooting and is not classified as an attack warning.
  condition: >
    evt.type in (execve, execveat) and evt.rawres >= 0 and
    pbl_v2_workload and proc.name = env
  output: >
    PBL_V2_EVENT detection=environment_inspection
    event_time_ns=%evt.rawtime event_type=%evt.type result=%evt.rawres
    process=%proc.name executable=%proc.exepath command=%proc.cmdline
    pid=%proc.pid tid=%thread.tid ppid=%proc.ppid
    parent=%proc.pname parent_command=%proc.pcmdline
    container_id=%container.id container=%container.name
    pod=%k8s.pod.name namespace=%k8s.ns.name
  priority: Informational
  tags: [pbl_v2, context, environment]
